#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. What if your ideas could change the way the world connects, powers up, or thinks? As a Cyber Security & Functional Safety Manager in our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


As a Cyber Security & Functional Safety Manager, you will play a key role in our Automotive R&D team by being responsible for managing and ensuring compliance with cybersecurity and safety processes throughout the product lifecycle, from concept and design through production and post-market support. This role is strongly aligned with ISO/SAE 21434 Automotive Cybersecurity Engineering and UNECE R155 Cybersecurity Management System (CSMS); Functional-Safety standards ISO 26262, and EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA EU).


  • Act as the go-to expert for Cyber Security (CS) & Functional Safety (FS) Management matters, coordinating towards secure solutions, driving audit proof assessments, and influencing cutting-edge architectural decisions to protect and future-proof critical systems
  • Ensure functional safety and cybersecurity compliance according to ISO 26262, ISO 21434, and CRA EU for products throughout the lifecycle
  • Guide projects towards conformity with CS and FS standards, review project plans and development deliverables to ensure alignment with internal requirements and applicable standards and approve the final compliance status
  • Drive the preparation of product audits and assessments 
  • Collaborate with international project teams including Development, Quality Assurance, Project Management and other relevant stakeholders
  • Continuously improve and simplify internal processes according to the related standards 

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

You are equipped with strong moderation and communication skills that enable seamless collaboration with cross-functional teams. With a self-driven, entrepreneurial mindset and cross-functional leadership abilities, you can independently drive topics to resolution and communicate outcomes clearly within the community. You’re eager to build long-lasting relationships within the organization's cybersecurity and functional-safety management network.


  • University Degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or in a related field
  • Professional experience in functional safety and cybersecurity according to ISO 26262 and ISO 21434 
  • Knowledge of CRA EU represents an advantage
  • Experience in automotive (or other highly regulated automotive industries) product development and maintenance, combined with a semiconductor hardware or firmware background
  • Systematic approach to analyzing product safety, security, and managing risks
  • Good knowledge of related standards to develop compliant products and quality management methods
  • Fluency in English 


Please send us your CV in English.


#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.
